description: Claude orchestration contract for deterministic MCP-based technical+conceptual regression review
objective: Review a change with business-flow awareness, run targeted non-regression checks, and return actionable findings.

questionTriggers: missing changed files and no git history
ambiguous business intent that changes review outcome

multiAgentRoles.focus: code quality, reliability, maintainability, security and integration risks
business flow correctness, UX impact, and side effects on onboarding/offboarding/profile/permissions
deterministic selection and execution of relevant Cypress specs
merge findings into a single prioritized recommendation set

deterministicWorkflow.purpose: load conceptual and product policy checks used by product-flow reviewer
ensure Cypress suite coverage exists for policy-defined flows
fail early if policy-required suite coverage is still incomplete
produce deterministic impacted flows, selected specs, execution summary, artifacts, and risk
ensure explicit gap analysis is included when mappings/specs are incomplete
